fit_complexity: n=input rows,P=input features,s<=32768 retained rows,q<=128 retained features,d=4q,v<=2048,k<=32 passes per ridge fit,t<=320 rounds per boosting stage,u<=8192 sampled rows,c<=48 searched features,h<=6,b<=64 bins: O(n(P+1)+P(min(s,384)+128)+q*s*log(s)+sum(k*s*d)+sum(t*(u*c*h+2^h*c*b+(s+v)*h))); includes internal selection and final refit
predict_complexity: m=prediction rows; remaining symbols as in fit: O(m*P+m*(q*log(b)+d+t*h))
memory_complexity: Excluding caller input: O(s*d+v*d+s*q+v*q+s+q*b+t*2^h) working; O(q*b+d+t*2^h) stored; O(m+q) extra prediction memory
